Recipe

Materials Satchel

Materials Satchel is a satchel crafted by Pearson in Red Dead Redemption 2. It takes 1 Perfect Boar Pelt, 1 Perfect Deer Pelt and 1 Perfect Iguana Skin. Part of Pearson's Satchel Collection.

Type
Satchel
Vendor
Pearson
Set
Pearson's Satchel Collection

Description

  • Increases the carrying capacity for mostly inedible Materials which can be used to craft a variety of items.

Ingredients

  • 1xPerfect Boar Pelt
  • 1xPerfect Deer Pelt
  • 1xPerfect Iguana Skin
